name: Clawtrate voice
description: Asks the bots to talk in a plain, friendly voice with no em dashes, and tells them what Clawtrate's words mean and how to move work into a task, in the system prompt of each run whose runner invokes its hook, until a person turns each off. Needs plugins.entries.clawtrate-voice.hooks.allowConversationAccess set to true. Not made by or affiliated with OpenClaw.
